caption:
Wall Street just closed its best week in over a year — and if you own an index fund, some of it is yours.

After an early-November selloff driven by AI-bubble fears wiped trillions off stocks, the market roared back. On Black Friday's half-day session, the Dow rose 1.18%, the S&P 500 1.60% and the Nasdaq 2.31%, led by AI and chip stocks. It capped the Dow's best week since 2022.

Here's the catch: even after that rally, the S&P 500 is still down for the month of November. The week was a sharp rebound, but the month was closer to a round trip.

This matters because most 401(k)s and retirement accounts — in the US and Canada — ride these same indexes. A violent week like this is exactly the kind that makes people check their balance too often.

My take: a great week doesn't erase a rough month. This was a recovery, not a new high — and the swings aren't over.

Did you check your 401(k) this week, or avoid looking? 👇
